snippet.description:
Powered by love, fueled by revenge. Experience Motor City showing at Regal July 24.

In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

Director: Potsy Ponciroli
Writers: Chad St. John
Stars: Alan Ritchson, Shailene Woodley, Ben McKenzie

snippet.title: The Doll | Official Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
What is the price of love?

A classic of Polish literature in an original contemporary reinterpretation in which love mixes with obsession and social status comes with a very high price. Stanisław, driven by ambition and blinded by desire to move up in the world tries to break into Warsaw’s high society and his fascination with Izabela becomes his obsession. Meanwhile very independent Izabela does everything she can to slip out of the narrow confines of aristocracy and redefine her place in a rapidly changing reality. The feeling that engulfs them is stretched between a chasm of class difference, the longing for freedom and the seductive power of wealth.

The six‑episode story, full of irony and secrets about ambition and class barriers is directed by Paweł Maślona (“Kos”) and the leading roles are played by Tomasz Schuchardt, Sandra Drzymalska, Dariusz Chojnacki and Jacek Braciak.

The series “The Doll” premieres September 16 - only on Netflix.

Watch on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/81615977

snippet.title: Elite Dangerous | Nomad - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Expanding the possibilities of surface exploration, Faulcon DeLacy presents the Nomad. Coming 30th June!   

This compact, ship-launched utility vessel has been designed for commanders to explore and navigate planetary terrain with exceptional manoeuvrability. Its nimble thrusters, responsive handling, small landing footprint and rapid spool-up capability makes it quick to set down, even in challenging environments, while a specialised MK II Biological Scanner enables the detection of biological signals directly from the cockpit.  

Designed with ease of use in mind, the Nomad features accessible entry points, supporting both rapid disembarkment and swift re-entry, allowing commanders to move around the vessel with ease. 

For more Elite Dangerous news, follow us on these sites:

Website: http://elitedangerous.com/
Facebook - http://fb.me/EliteDangerousOfficial
Twitter - https://twitter.com/EliteDangerous
Instagram - https://instagram.com/elitedangerous/

snippet.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner - Official Trailer (2026)
snippet.description: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. snippet.title: Daniel: The Fiery Furnace | Official Movie Trailer | In Theaters This September
snippet.description:
Coming exclusively to theaters September 2026!

"Daniel: The Fiery Furnace" is an epic live-action biblical drama that brings the origin story of the prophet Daniel to life against the backdrop of exile in Babylon. As Daniel rises within a powerful and unforgiving empire, a ruthless king issues a decree demanding absolute worship under penalty of death. When three faithful men—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—refuse to bow, they choose to be cast into a blazing furnace rather than betray their God. In the face of impossible odds, their defiance ignites a miracle that is seen around the world.

Starring Mena Massoud (Aladdin) and Elijah Alexander (The Chosen), this powerful drama is a stirring testament to courage, resilience, and unwavering faith when everything is on the line.

Written and directed by award-winning filmmakers The Kooman Brothers, Matthew and Daniel (She Has a Name), produced by The Kooman Brothers with Travis Mann (Executive Producer, Reagan, I Can Only Imagine) and Mena Massoud, who also stars.

snippet.title: All You Need Is Love (Live from Abbey Road Studios, June 25th, 1967)
snippet.description:
The Beatles perform “All You Need Is Love” live for Our World — June 25, 1967 🌍

Broadcast to over 400 million people across 26 countries, Our World was the first ever live global satellite TV event. For the occasion, The Beatles performed ‘All You Need Is Love’ for the first time, capturing the spirit of the Summer of Love in a single moment seen around the world.

Filmed at Abbey Road Studios, the band performed live vocals over a pre-recorded backing track, surrounded by friends and fellow icons including Mick Jagger, Eric Clapton, Keith Richards, Keith Moon, and Marianne Faithfull.

This performance stands as one of the defining cultural moments of 1967 — a message of unity, broadcast across the globe.

Lyrics: 
Love, love, love.
Love, love, love.
Love, love, love.

There's nothing you can do that can't be done.
Nothing you can sing that can't be sung.
Nothing you can say but you can learn how to play the game.
It's easy.

Nothing you can make that can't be made.
No one you can save that can't be saved.
Nothing you can do, but you can learn how to be you in time.
It's easy

All you need is love.
All you need is love.
All you need is love, love.
Love is all you need.

All you need is love.

Love is all you need.

There's nothing you can know that isn't known.

Благодаря на www.saloncare.eu за nogkpenama и сьдействието при
реализирането на този проект.
Част от оборудването, използвано по време на снимките беше любезно
предоставено от тях.

Розовите очила

Със непознати, каза, няма да си пише,
главата си залагам, верен ми е като куче!
Видели го били със друга на кафе,
може всичко пък да е, братовчедка да му е..

Червило някакво по дрехите му има,
изцапал се е в магазина докато ми взима..
Под снимкита на друга сложил е сърце,
е, на всеки случва се, знам, че без да иска е..

Розовите очила пак съм си ги сложила,
гледай го какъв е, просто мъж мечта!
Розовите очила май съм ги изцапала,
струва ли ми се или видях лъжа?!

Писах му, ама не отговаря с часове,
миличкия, сигурно от кеф припаднал е..
Дано да е така, че иначе - беля,
знам къде държи баща ми пушката!

Да видя снимка как със друга се целува
ще кажа "Интриганти, фотошопа ви не струва!”
И на челото му си пише, че е мой,
същото ще каже той, кой ще го попита, кой?!

До късно пак работи, да му се не знае,
работния ми той, колко много се старае..
Ако не звънне, вкъщи не се прибере,
няма друго кво да е, сигурно отвлечен е!

Припев..

#Preslava #RozoviteOchila #Розовитеочила

snippet.title: SAWLA BATEU ( Official Video ) Armaan Malik | Anjali 99 | Chirayu, Ayaan, Zaid, Tuba
snippet.description:
Disclaimer :- इस वीडियो में दिखाए गए सभी दृश्य, पात्र और घटनाएं पूरी तरह से काल्पनिक हैं।
इसका उद्देश्य केवल दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करना है।
इसका मकसद किसी भी समुदाय, संस्कृति, परंपरा या भावनाओं को ठेस पहुंचाना नहीं है।
पूरी Malik Family  और सारा  India बाल विवाह के खिलाफ है,
बाल विवाह एक सामाजिक बुराई और कानूनन अपराध है। यह वीडियो केवल मनोंरजन के लिए बनाई गयी है, हम सभी से अनुरोध करते हैं कि बाल विवाह जैसी कुप्रथा का विरोध करें
तथा बच्चों को शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य और उज्ज्वल भविष्य का अधिकार दिलाने में सहयोग करें
इस वीडियो के फिल्मांकन (Shooting) के दौरान इस्तेमाल किए गए घोड़े (पशु) की सुरक्षा और देखभाल का पूरा ध्यान रखा गया है।
वीडियो की शूटिंग के दौरान किसी भी जानवर को कोई नुकसान, चोट या प्रताड़ित नहीं किया गया है।सभी दृश्य विशेषज्ञों की देखरेख में और सुरक्षित माहौल में फिल्माए गए हैं।
इस वीडियो में छोटे बच्चों को पारंपरिक/शादी की पोशाक (Festive/Traditional Attire) केवल एक कलात्मक थीम और सांस्कृतिक अभिनय के हिस्से के रूप में पहनाई गई है।
यह प्रोडक्शन हाउस और इसके कलाकार बाल विवाह (Child Marriage) जैसी सामाजिक कुरीतियों का कड़ा विरोध करते हैं और किसी भी रूप में इसका समर्थन नहीं करते हैं।
वीडियो की शूटिंग पूरी तरह से बच्चों के माता-पिता/अभिभावकों (Parents/Guardians) की उपस्थिति, उनकी लिखित सहमति और सुरक्षित माहौल में की गई है।
फिल्मांकन के दौरान बच्चों की मानसिक और शारीरिक सुरक्षा का पूरा ध्यान रखा गया है।


Number 1 Records & Armaan Malik Presents New song " SAWLA BATEU "
Make a reel on this sound:-  

Song:-  SAWLA BATEU 
Staring:- Armaan Malik, Payal Malik, Kritika Malik, Chirayu, Zaid, Ayaan, Tuba , Navya Ramavat
Singer:- Armaan Malik, Anjali 99, Vinod Sorkhi
Lyrics & Composer:- Rohit Malik
Director:- Armaan Malik
Music:- Vikash Haryanvi
Producer:- Armaan Malik
Choreographer :- ADDY
Label:- Number 1 Records

snippet.description:
The official German lyric video of “Have You Ever Seen The Rain” taken from Creedence Clearwater Revival’s greatest hits collection, Chronicle.

Follow Creedence Clearwater Revival:

https://ccr.concord.com/products/

Subscribe to the CCR Newsletter: https://manage.kmail-lists.com/subscriptions/subscribe?a=Ut6Y6V&g=WyE6eZ

About Creedence Clearwater Revival: 
Creedence Clearwater Revival’s 1968 self-titled debut album introduced the world to guitar-playing brothers John and Tom Fogerty, drummer Doug Clifford, and bassist Stu Cook, four young men out of El Cerrito in the San Francisco Bay Area. Though they emerged in a place and time where trippy psychedelic visions were the order of the day, CCR bucked the trends and instead tapped into a rich, traditional seam of American music that connected to blues, country, rockabilly, gospel, folk, and R&B.    

During their short time together as a band (1968 – 1972), the band enjoyed an unparalleled period of creativity led by singer, songwriter, arranger John Fogerty. They’ve sold close to 100 million records, releasing 14 Top 10 hits. They also managed to play over 150 tour dates around the world, including a headlining spot at Woodstock.

Creedence Clearwater Revival’s canon has become a part of the Great American Songbook. Fogerty penned songs like “Bad Moon Rising,” “Down on the Corner,” “Fortunate Son,” “Have You Ever Seen the Rain,” “Proud Mary,” “Born on the Bayou,” “Travelin’ Band,” and “Up Around the Bend” have been ingrained into pop culture — not just as rock staples, but as classic standards.

With so many memorable songs that continue to grace our radio waves, television, and movie screens, plus lyrics that still resonate today, Creedence Clearwater Revival is, truly, America’s greatest rock ’n’ roll band.

snippet.title: Can You Beat GTA V Using Only SNOW BALLS?
snippet.description:
I finally attempted the GTA V Snow Run, a challenge my community has joked about for years, where I try to beat the entire story while everyone can only use snowballs. What started as a ridiculous meme immediately became a broken nightmare as missions crashed, enemies became strangely deadly, simple fights took forever, snowballs behaved nothing like normal weapons, and some missions had to be bent as far as possible just to keep the run alive. From Prologue to the final choice, this was a full Grand Theft Auto V challenge run built around the dumbest possible weapon, endless snow jokes, Christmas chaos, broken mission scripting, and the horrible discovery that snowballs are somehow one of the hardest weapons in the game to use.
